title: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Coverage Terms for Insulin, Preventive Drugs, Vaccines and OTC Products
content:
These terms of the Pharmacy Benefit Plan govern what the member is charged for covered insulin, ACA preventive drugs, ACIP vaccines and over-the-counter (OTC) products.

## Terms

**(a) Insulin.** Covered insulin is charged the lesser of the tier cost share and the design's insulin cap per 30-day supply.

**(b) ACA preventive drugs.** Where the design provides ACA preventive drugs at zero member cost share, ACA preventive drugs are charged zero.

**(c) Vaccines.** Where the design provides ACIP vaccines at a network pharmacy at zero member cost share, ACIP vaccines given at a network pharmacy are charged zero.

**(d) OTC products.** OTC products are covered at tier 1 only when the design covers OTC products with a prescription and a prescription is on file. Otherwise they are not covered and nothing posts to the member's accumulators.

## OTC coverage in every combination

| The design covers OTC products with a prescription | A prescription is on file | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Covered at tier 1 |
| Yes | No | Not covered; nothing posts |
| No | Yes | Not covered; nothing posts |
| No | No | Not covered; nothing posts |

## Insulin: both sides of the cap (hypothetical figures)

With a hypothetical insulin cap of 30.00 for a 30-day supply:

| Tier cost share the insulin would otherwise carry | Lesser of tier cost share and the cap | Member is charged |
|---|---|---|
| 18.00 | 18.00 | 18.00 |
| 30.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 |
| 62.50 | 30.00 | 30.00 |

The cap therefore only ever lowers the charge; when the tier cost share is already below the cap, the tier cost share is what the member pays.

## Questions answered by these terms

**What is an OTC product that is covered at tier 1 charged?** The tier 1 cost share of the member's design, since it is covered at tier 1.

**Does an OTC product bought without a prescription on file count toward the deductible or out-of-pocket maximum?** No. It is not covered, and nothing posts.

**Is a vaccine at zero member cost share wherever it is given?** Term (c) provides zero member cost share for an ACIP vaccine given at a network pharmacy; it says nothing about any other setting.
